name: syncrecord/watch-php
description: PHP client for Sync Record Watch: errors, logs, performance, outside API calls, jobs, deploys, heartbeats and vulnerable packages.

suggest.ext-curl: Preferred HTTP transport (falls back to PHP streams without it)
suggest.ext-zlib: Gzip-compresses what is sent to Watch
suggest.psr/log: Use Watch::logger() as a real Psr\Log\LoggerInterface (Adapter\Psr3Logger)
suggest.psr/http-server-middleware: PSR-15 middleware that names and times requests (Adapter\Psr15Middleware)
suggest.psr/http-client: PSR-18 client decorator that times outgoing calls (Adapter\Psr18Client)
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Guzzle middleware that times outgoing calls (Adapter\GuzzleMiddleware)
